facts.fact: The Nigerian Communications Commission held its first public consultation forum in Abuja on the proposed framework for zero-rated access to educational platforms and content, with the telecom operators' association ALTON, UNESCO, uLesson Group and the Nigerian Governors' Forum among those present; the date 14 July 2026 comes from the source's ingest note, the article saying only Tuesday.
